cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outfeel the Room
cards.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your opening had empty seats? Mine had two people, and both left. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Have my complimentary drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Thank you. My theatre couldn't even afford to console us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you listen now? My dad left before my scene.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine asked for a refund. Could you stay while I finish this? I haven't told anyone that.

mechanism: A organizes mutual consolation but responds to B disappointment with a worse personal version and adjusts a drink-sharing offer to keep B attention on A.
confusable: Unlike an empathetic matching story, A repeatedly takes priority for A hurt; S02 preserves cooperation through offers and requests around consolation.
comparison: Opening-night family hurt and a offered drink differ from scarce rehearsal time before interviews.
seedUse: D115-b sparse audience, consolation drink and parental refund; S02-a alters a confident shared plan after B needs surface.
